items.title: 68514_Horace Henderson oral history interview
items.q: And when you said Look Stewart, the Luke banjo player -- played banjo.

ctx.x: Yes. But he comes out of retirement, speaking of that particular thing, every now and then and he makes appearances on TV, on the -- sometimes the big shows that migrate out of LA might (inaudible) out of Ellic and all. And he ma still plays.
Huh. Let's see, Also they weren't able to list the drummer here. They have Luke Look Stewart, guitar, Sylvester Turpin on bass, and do you recall who the drummer was at that time?
I had a drummer named Jimmy King. He's deceased now. And when you said Look Stewart, the Luke banjo player -- played banjo.
